notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A single-page, offline-capable logbook. You define scenarios and blocks, it generates a randomized complete block design (RCBD) visit schedule, and it times each point, records receiver power-on/RTK-fix times and weather, and exports the session as CSV or JSON. Data used in the run: none. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
